description: This Java class 'DefaultHealthCheckConfig' provides the default implementation of the 'HealthCheckConfig' interface, encapsulating health check configuration details such as basic health check settings and persistence configuration. It includes methods for creating instances from a Config object, and overrides for equality, hash code, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultHealthCheckConfig
classes.description: Default implementation of the HealthCheckConfig interface, managing health check and persistence configurations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultHealthCheckConfig from a given Config object, reading nested configuration for health check and persistence settings.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the health check is enabled, delegating to BasicHealthCheckConfig.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval Duration for health checks, delegating to BasicHealthCheckConfig.

methods.name: getPersistenceConfig
methods.description: Returns the PersistenceConfig object associated with this health check configuration.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on basicHealthCheckConfig and persistenceConfig.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on basicHealthCheckConfig and persistenceConfig.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including class name and configuration details.
